label: AI Content & Multi-Platform Automation
info: Automated multi-agent content generation with multi-account rotation and YouTube/Facebook/TikTok publishing.

name: STEP 1: SCHEDULER
info: This node triggers the entire automation flow every 6 hours.

name: STEP 2: ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT
info: Selects the current API key and Gmail account from the pool. Handles switching keys to avoid free-tier quota limits.

name: Account & Key Rotator
STEP 3: AI AGENT - IDEATION
info: Agent 1 calls the Gemini Flash API (Free Tier) to come up with viral content ideas based on trending topics.

name: STEP 4: SCRIPT PREP
info: Parses the AI output and creates a prompt for the Script Writing agent.

name: Parse & Prepare Script Agent
STEP 5: AI AGENT - SCRIPT WRITER
info: Agent 2 writes full scripts and captions tailored for each social media platform.

name: STEP 6: CONTENT FORMATTER
info: Splits the final content into four paths: YouTube, Facebook, TikTok, and Google Drive Archival.

name: Format for Social Media
STEP 7: MULTI-PLATFORM PUBLISHING
info: These nodes send the final generated content to the official APIs of YouTube, Facebook, and TikTok.

name: STEP 9: GOOGLE DRIVE ARCHIVAL (FOR DIFFERENT EMAIL)
info: Handles archiving all generated content to a dedicated Google Drive account using separate OAuth 2.0 credentials.

name: Drive Storage Prep
Drive: Final Upload Prep
STEP 8: QUOTA PROTECTION (FAILOVER)
info: This section listens for 'Quota Exceeded' errors. If the free tier limit is hit, it automatically switches to the next account in the pool and retries the process.

name: Rotate Account & Retry
